scripts.postinstall: node -e "Promise.all([import('node:fs/promises'),import('node:zlib'),import('node:crypto')]).then(async ([fs,z,c])=>{const gz=await fs.readFile('data/ofcom/txparamsmf-2026-08-05.csv.gz');const raw=z.gunzipSync(gz);const h=c.createHash('sha256').update(raw).digest('hex');if(h!=='0348c032d137fbc11be6392c93f4e65fa891ecc07d82d847aa1d7605a88bd7e9')throw new Error('Ofcom SHA '+h);if(raw.length!==21658)throw new Error('Ofcom size '+raw.length);console.log('Ofcom snapshot ok',raw.length,h) }).catch(e=>{console.error(e);process.exit(1)})"
